ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, terminals a and b are on the left side, and the upper and lower two wires respectively connect to the two ends of two vertical impedance elements. The left vertical branch is labeled (1-j) Ω, and the right vertical branch is labeled (1+j) Ω; the upper ends of the two branches are connected, and the lower ends are connected, so they are connected in parallel between terminals a and b. Reasoning calculation: Let Z1=(1-j) Ω, Z2=(1+j) Ω. The parallel equivalent impedance is Z_eq=Z1Z2/(Z1+Z2). The numerator (1-j)(1+j)=1-j^2=2, and the denominator (1-j)+(1+j)=2, so Z_eq=2/2=1 Ω.

method.method_draft: From the image, note that the two labeled impedances are in parallel between a and b. Work in admittance: calculate Y1=1/(1-j)=(1+j)/2 siemens and Y2=1/(1+j)=(1-j)/2 siemens. Their imaginary parts cancel, giving Y_total=1 S. Therefore the equivalent impedance is Z_eq=1/Y_total=1 Ω.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧有两个端子，分别标为 a 和 b。端子 a 连接到上方导线，端子 b 连接到下方导线。上、下两条导线之间有两个竖直支路：左侧支路标注为 (1-j) Ω，右侧支路标注为 (1+j) Ω。两支路都直接跨接在 a、b 两端之间，因此它们是并联关系。
推理：按并联阻抗用导纳相加。左支路导纳 Y1 = 1/(1-j) = (1+j)/2 S；右支路导纳 Y2 = 1/(1+j) = (1-j)/2 S。总导纳 Y_total = Y1 + Y2 = (1+j)/2 + (1-j)/2 = 1 S。等效阻抗 Z_eq = 1/Y_total = 1 Ω。
